traits.name: Implant Eggs
traits.text: ⬻ The giant wasp lays eggs in an adjacent creature that is paralyzed or unconscious, exposing it to the wasp larva disease.

traits.name: Giant Wasp Venom
traits.text: (incapacitation, poison); Saving Throw DC 19 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 no effect (1 round) Stage 2 clumsy 2 (1 round) Stage 3 paralyzed (1 round)

traits.name: Wasp Larva
traits.text: (disease); Saving Throw DC 21 Fortitude. Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1d6 (1d6) days) Stage 2 drained 1 (1d3 (1d3) days) Stage 3 5d6 (5d6) damage, larva emerges (disease ends)

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ stinger +12 (poison); Damage 1d12+4 (1d12+4) piercing plus giant wasp venom
